evidence.title: GitHub - TanStack/table: Headless UI for building powerful tables & datagrids for TS/JS.

name: TanStack Table
summary: Headless table engine for data grids: sorting, filtering, pagination, grouping, selection, pinning and resizing.
description: A headless, framework-agnostic table and datagrid library. It supplies state and typed APIs for sorting, pagination, filtering, faceting, grouping, aggregation, row expansion, row and cell selection, cell spanning, column pinning, ordering, visibility and resizing, while you render your own markup with any component library. Features are tree-shakable, row models are memoized, and adapters cover React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, Angular and more; Devtools and agent skills ship with v9+.
contains: 1.2B total downloads, 32M weekly downloads, 28k+ GitHub stars
sorting, pagination, filtering, faceting, grouping, aggregation and row expansion
row and cell selection, cell spanning, row and column pinning
headless: 100% control of markup and styles; examples for shadcn/ui, MUI, Mantine, Chakra UI, HeroUI, React Aria
tree-shakable features and a memoized row-model pipeline
TanStack Table Devtools and v9 agent skills
